ValidationRule.description: Prevent edit of expense line by HOD if the HOD has already approved the expense.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh HOD", NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED(Expense__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Pending HR Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Pending ED Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Approved By ED"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Reimbursed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit an Expense Line if the Expense is in one of Pending HR Approval, Pending ED Approval, Approved by ED or Reimbursed states.
